products.name: Kinesys Apex Hoist 500
products.blurb: 500 kg variable-speed hoist, 30 m/min, designed for movement over people.
products.detail: Kinesys Apex Hoist 500 kg variable speed chain hoist, max speed 500 mm/s (30 m/min). Silent brakes, ability to hover. Compatible with Apex Drive v2 and Kinesys/TAIT control.

products.name: Kinesys Apex Hoist 500 Servo
products.blurb: 500 kg servo-driven hoist, DGUV 17 / EN 17206, SIL3 load cell.
products.detail: Kinesys Apex Hoist 500 Servo - meets DGUV 17 (BGV C1) and EN 17206. Powered by Kinesys Apex Drive v2. Operates from Vector or TAIT Navigator. Integrated SIL3 load cell.

products.name: Kinesys Apex Hoist 1250
products.blurb: 1.25 t variable speed hoist, C1-rated, for performance flying and SOTA loads.
products.detail: Kinesys Apex Hoist 1250 kg variable speed chain hoist, max speed 200 mm/s (12 m/min). C1-rated for movement over people. Silent brakes, hover capable.

products.name: Kinesys Elevation Hoist 250
products.blurb: Variable speed converted Liftket, 250 kg.
products.detail: Kinesys Elevation Hoist 250 kg variable speed Liftket / Stageket body. Updated with new latching chain hook and black chain, 24 m height of lift options.

products.name: Kinesys Elevation Hoist 500
products.blurb: Variable speed converted Liftket, 500 kg.
products.detail: Kinesys Elevation Hoist 500 kg variable speed Liftket / Stageket body. Shares mechanical parts with the Apex Hoist 500. 24 m height of lift options.

products.name: Kinesys Elevation Hoist 1000
products.blurb: Variable speed converted Liftket, 1000 kg.
products.detail: Kinesys Elevation Hoist 1000 kg variable speed Liftket / Stageket body. Suitable for SOTA applications when paired with Mentor and Libra Cell.

products.name: Kinesys Elevation Hoist Lodestar
products.blurb: Kinesys-converted CM Lodestar with Elevation1+ variable-speed control.
products.detail: Kinesys converted Lodestar - combines CM Lodestar lifting mechanism with Elevation1+ control. Double brakes, limit switches, encoder. With Libra Cell can reach the most restrictive safety standards.

products.name: Kinesys Apex Drive v2
products.blurb: SIL3 variable-speed drive for Apex hoist range, Kinesys and TAIT compatible.
products.detail: State-of-the-art Apex Drive v2. Compliant with the latest safety directives. Compatible with both Kinesys and TAIT automation control. Works with all Kinesys Apex hoist models.

products.name: Kinesys Elevation Drive v2
products.blurb: Flexible variable-speed open-system drive for Lodestar, Liftket and GIS hoists.
products.detail: Kinesys Elevation Drive v2 reduces cabling by supplying motors and controllers via single power and data cables. Works with Lodestar, Liftket and GIS chain hoists.

products.name: Kinesys DigiHoist
products.blurb: Compact digital chain-hoist controller with limit, load and position feedback.
products.detail: Digital communications, limit monitoring, load and position feedback and group halt functionality. Multiple units daisy-chained with automatic channel addressing.

products.name: Kinesys Vector Console
products.blurb: All-in-one cue-based console with built-in PC running Vector software.
products.detail: All-in-one control solution with built-in dedicated PC running Vector software. Keypad mirrors familiar Kinesys layout.

products.name: Kinesys Vector Software
products.blurb: Cue-based motion control software for Kinesys and TAIT hardware.
products.detail: Kinesys Vector allows cues to be built and run with a variety of linking options. Channels and cues limited only by your imagination. Advanced linking features for complex cue structures.

products.name: Kinesys Mentor Safety Series 4
products.blurb: SIL3 safety controller, up to 60 devices over Ethernet.
products.detail: Mentor Series 4 - SIL3 safety over Ethernet, can communicate with and safely control up to 60 devices. E-stops and enable switches common across the Mentor range.

products.name: Kinesys Mentor Safety Series 3
products.blurb: Interface between Kinesys Elevation and DigiHoist emergency-stop systems.
products.detail: Mentor products provide the key interface between Kinesys product ranges, allowing E-stop systems built into Elevation and DigiHoist Ranges to work together.

products.name: Kinesys Libra Watch
products.blurb: Multi-platform load monitoring app, tabular / graphical / plan view.
products.detail: Portable, user-friendly load monitoring software. Multi-platform - runs on any computer, tablet or smartphone. Tabular, graphical or plan view. Works with Libra Cell, Libra Pro and Libra WiFi.

products.name: Kinesys Libra View
products.blurb: PC load monitoring software with logging and CSV export.
products.detail: Live readout of weights from Libra Cells with logging and archiving (kg or lbs). All activity can be logged and exported to CSV.

products.name: Kinesys Elevation Trolley DST
products.blurb: Horizontal motorised trolley module for the Elevation DST stacking truss.
products.detail: Modular trolley system - motorized, slave and rotation trolleys. Compatible with Kinesys Elevation system via adapters and couplings. Variable speed.

products.name: Kinesys Elevation Rotator DST
products.blurb: 360 degree rotation module for the Elevation DST stacking truss.
products.detail: 360 degree rotation module for the Kinesys Elevation DST system. Stacking truss compatible. Variable speed via Elevation drive.

products.name: Kinesys Elevation Track Truss DST
products.blurb: Custom-built stacking track truss for the Elevation DST modular trolley system.
products.detail: Custom-built stacking track truss for the Elevation DST modular trolley system. Adapters and couplings link to the wider Elevation ecosystem.

products.name: Kinesys Libra Cell
products.blurb: Load-measuring shackle for indoor use, Crosby-compatible shackle pin.
products.detail: Load measuring shackle. Combined with the Kinesys Libra system produces accurate, real-time load info. Designed for indoor use (not waterproof). Libra shackle pin works with Crosby safety bow shackles (3.25TE / 4.75TE).

products.name: Kinesys Libra Pro
products.blurb: Load-cell controller with 4x XLR4 outputs, up to 100 cells monitored.
products.detail: Four XLR4 outputs, up to 100 load cells monitored. Four programmable relay outputs and Ethernet connectivity. USB and Ethernet for integration.

products.name: Kinesys Libra Basic
products.blurb: USB-connected entry-level Libra controller, up to 25 cells.
products.detail: Works with Libra View software. USB socket for simple connection. External universal power supply. Powers up to 25 Libra Cells from a single XLR4.

products.name: Kinesys Libra WiFi
products.blurb: Wireless Libra access point with built-in firewall, mountable to truss.
products.detail: Wireless Libra access point - aerial mountable to any truss. Built-in firewall permits only Kinesys data. Works with all Kinesys systems. Kinesys recommends wired networks during performance.

products.name: Kinesys Libra Split
products.blurb: Distribution unit connecting multiple Libra Cells to a single Libra Pro / Basic / DigiHoist port.
products.detail: Flexible connection of multiple Libra Cells to a single data connector on Libra Pro, Libra Basic and DigiHoist. Robust extruded aluminium case, low-voltage DC power.

products.name: Kinesys Libra Rig
products.blurb: Lifting accessory linking 4.75TE Libra Cell to a 3.25 standard bow shackle.
products.detail: Lifting accessory connecting a 4.75TE Libra Cell shackle to a 3.25 standard bow shackle. Cells stay assembled during load in/out. Saves hook height vs an O-ring.

products.name: Kinesys Libra Node
products.blurb: OEM module that bridges 3rd-party 0-10V / 4-20mA / strain-gauge sensors to Libra.
products.detail: Connects 3rd-party load sensors to the Libra Range. Reads 0-10V, 4-20mA and strain-gauge inputs. Designed for OEMs. Outputs for driving LEDs.

products.name: Kinesys Array PD-ES
products.blurb: 6U 19in rack, 125A E-stop switched power, four 32A 3ph Ceeform outlets.
products.detail: 6U 19in rack module - 125A E-stop switched power through four 32A three-phase Ceeform outlets. Adjustable RCD per outlet. Single-phase auxiliary. Dual XLR7 data outputs. Transform 485 functionality.

products.name: Kinesys Array PD-ES Mini
products.blurb: 32A E-stop switched power, two 32A 3ph Ceeform outlets, with Transform 485.
products.detail: 32A E-stop switched power through two 32A three-phase Ceeform outlets. Single-phase auxiliary outlet. Adjustable RCD. Includes Transform 485 between Vector and Elevation.

products.name: Kinesys Array IP8
products.blurb: Rugged 8-port 10/100 Ethernet switch with Ethercon connectors.
products.detail: Rugged 8 port 10/100 Ethernet switch designed to work with Kinesys products. Ethercon connectors on the rear for 8 x RJ45 (standard RJ-45 also accepted). Power and per-channel activity LEDs.

products.name: Kinesys Array 485
products.blurb: 1-in-8-out RS485 distribution unit for Elevation v2.
products.detail: 1 in 8 out RS485 distribution for Elevation v2. Rear: 1 in / 8 out XLR7. Front: link, data and E-stop status indicators plus a Rigger remote socket for local hoist control.

products.name: Kinesys Transform 485
products.blurb: Protocol bridge between Vector/K2 Ethernet and Elevation RS485 (XLR7).
products.detail: Translates between native Ethernet from Vector/K2 controllers and the RS485 bus on the Elevation range (XLR7). Built-in E-stop button for instant network E-stop.

products.name: Kinesys DigiHandset
products.blurb: DigiHoist handset: channel select, E-STOP, GO and RESET.
products.detail: DigiHandset with channel selection, Emergency STOP, GO and RESET. Auto-addresses on plug-in. Blue indicator per channel when a hoist is connected and ready.

products.name: Kinesys DigiLink
products.blurb: Links up to four DigiHandsets - one GO button controls up to 96 hoists.
products.detail: Connects up to four DigiHandsets so a single handset GO button can control up to 96 hoists. Useful for systems greater than 32 channels.

products.name: Kinesys Elevation Rigger
products.blurb: Industry-standard hand-held controller for Elevation 1+ variable-speed hoists.
products.detail: Hand-held Rigger remote - minimal training required. Operates variable speed chain hoists alongside or in place of a Vector control system. Uses the Elevation 1+ menu system.

products.name: TAIT Navigator
products.blurb: TAIT's flagship cue-based automation control platform.
products.detail: TAIT Navigator multi-axis automation control. Cue-based, scalable to large permanent installations. Compatible with Kinesys Apex Hoist 500/1250/500 Servo and Apex Drive v2 (confirmed by Kinesys product pages). Pairs with Acrobat module for performer flying.
products.source: Referenced as compatible control on kinesys.com Apex pages

products.name: TAIT Acrobat
products.blurb: Performer flying control module for the Navigator platform.
products.detail: TAIT Acrobat - performer flying module integrated with Navigator. Used on large arena and stadium tours. Specs to be confirmed against internal TAIT documentation.
products.source: Referenced as compatible control on kinesys.com Apex pages
